name: usage_units_by_tenant_period
source_sql: SELECT tenant_id AS "tenant_id", TO_CHAR(occurred_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS "period", SUM(units) AS "units_total", COUNT(*) AS "event_count" FROM ow_billing.usage_events GROUP BY tenant_id, TO_CHAR(occurred_at, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY 1, 2
target_sql: SELECT tenant_id, date_format(occurred_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS period, SUM(units) AS units_total, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM ow_tp.silver.usage_events GROUP BY tenant_id, date_format(occurred_at, 'yyyy-MM') ORDER BY 1, 2

name: usage_kind_cd_is_a_known_usage_kind
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "unknown_kind_rows" FROM ow_billing.usage_events u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ow_billing.codes c WHERE c.code_type = 'USAGE_KIND' AND c.code_val = u.kind_cd)
target_sql: SELECT count_if(kind_cd NOT IN (SELECT code_val FROM ow_tp.bronze.codes WHERE code_type = 'USAGE_KIND')) AS unknown_kind_rows FROM ow_tp.silver.usage_events

name: usage_units_are_positive
source_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "non_positive_rows", MIN(units) AS "min_units" FROM ow_billing.usage_events WHERE NVL(units, 0) <= 0
target_sql: SELECT count_if(units IS NULL OR units <= 0) AS non_positive_rows, min(CASE WHEN units IS NULL OR units <= 0 THEN units END) AS min_units FROM ow_tp.silver.usage_events
